# Sahyak CRM

> Mobile-first real estate CRM software engineered for property brokers, channel partners, and developers.

## Overview
Sahyak CRM is specialized workflow and productivity software for real estate sales teams. It provides mobile-optimized lead management, direct Meta WhatsApp Cloud API integration, site visit tracking with GPS check-in, property inventory tracking, and deal pipeline management.

## Core Capabilities
- **Lead Capture & Routing**: Real-time webhook ingestion from 99acres, Magicbricks, and Meta Lead Ads. Automated round-robin routing to active sales executives.
- **WhatsApp Cloud API Integration**: Direct integration via official Meta Business Cloud API with 0% markup on provider fees. Interactive message templates with brochures and project floor plans.
- **Site Visit Management**: Automated appointment coordination via WhatsApp with Google Maps navigation pins, project directions, and sales executive contact cards. GPS-verified field check-in for attendance confirmation.
- **Sales Pipeline & Stale Deal Triggers**: Multi-stage deal velocity tracking (New, Contacted, Visit Scheduled, Visit Done, Negotiating, Won, Lost) with automated reminders for inactive prospects.
- **Inventory Management**: Tower and unit availability matrices, floor plan viewing, and instant brochure dispatch on mobile.
- **Data Security & Privacy**: Logical tenant isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest, HTTPS/TLS in transit. Aligned with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023).

## Commercial Pricing
- **Free Starter Tier**: ₹0 forever for up to 20 leads, 1 user seat, 10 WhatsApp actions, and 3 properties. No credit card required.
- **Base Access**: ₹499/month in India ($59 USD/mo international) for core CRM access.
- **Add-On Packs**: Modular pricing for additional user seats, lead volume, and storage without forced multi-month lock-in contracts.
